title: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missile from Wonsan Toward East Sea
detail: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff reported at least one ballistic missile fired from the Wonsan area into the sea off the east coast on the morning of Oct 3 (KST), flying over 700 km (Japan estimated ~680 km). The launch came days after Seoul blamed Pyongyang for a Sept 21 DMZ blast that wounded three South Korean soldiers; Seoul's presidential security office held an emergency meeting and Japan issued an alert.

media.caption: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward the sea (file photo of a 2025 test)
